title: vesta.json
description: A game's settings for Vesta (https://github.com/VanitasCaesar1/vesta-arcade). Created by `vesta publish`.

slug.description: URL name of the game. Publishing again with the same slug creates a new version.

description.description: What the game is and how to play it.

madeWith.description: AI tools used, e.g. ["Claude Code"]. Detected automatically if left out.

dir.description: Build folder, relative to vesta.json. Detected automatically (dist, build, out, …).

build.description: Command run by `vesta publish --build`. Defaults to the package.json build script.

cover.description: Cover image path: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF under 2 MB, ideally 1200×675.

keyboardRequired.description: Shows a keyboard notice, useful for phone players.
